Captivity, warfare, and the expanding colonial economy imposed severe costs, even as some people gained wealth. Local institutions and kinship continued to organize social life amid these pressures.
simp_chinese:
亚内卡属于北美东南内陆的奇克索地区，耕作聚落和周围猎地支撑着相互联系的原住民社会。玉米、豆类、南瓜、猎物和采集的植物提供多样食物。道路与水道连接邻近人群，他们之间的关系包括交换、联盟和竞争。

殖民时期，欧洲贸易为已有的政治关系带来制成品和新需求。奇克索人的外交和军事力量影响着他们同法国、英国、西班牙及邻近原住民势力的关系。俘掳、战争和扩大的殖民经济使一些人获利，也给另一些人造成严重伤害。地方制度与亲属关系在这些压力下继续组织社群生活。

english: The Yanesha inhabit the wooded eastern foothills of the central Peruvian Andes, among the valleys of the Perené and neighbouring rivers. Their communities maintained connections with both the highlands and the Amazonian forest. In 1742 Juan Santos Atahualpa began a revolt against Spanish missionaries and settlers; Yanesha leaders joined Asháninka and other peoples in a movement that drove the missions from much of the central forest.
simp_chinese: 亚内沙人居住在秘鲁中部安第斯东麓的森林地带，生活于佩雷内河及邻近河流的谷地。他们的社群与高地和亚马孙森林均保持联系。1742年，胡安·桑托斯·阿塔瓦尔帕发动反抗西班牙传教士和移民的起义；亚内沙领袖与阿沙宁卡等族群一道参加，将传教站赶出中部森林的大片地区。

english: Yanga country lies in the inland Gulf region of northern Queensland. Yanga and Mbara are closely related but distinct Aboriginal languages, associated with neighbouring peoples. Their lands include the river country and plains between the Gulf of Carpentaria and the inland ranges.
simp_chinese: 扬加人的土地位于昆士兰北部的海湾内陆地区。扬加语与姆巴拉语密切相关，却是两种不同的原住民语言，分别与相邻人群有关。他们的土地包括卡奔塔利亚湾与内陆山岭之间的河流和平原地区。

english: Yangabad lies in the Jarquya country southeast of Isfahan, where oasis villages are scattered across the dry interior. Its cultivated land depends on water brought through underground channels, contrasting with the barren plain beyond. The district was divided into upper and lower Jarquya, each with its own chain of settlements. Yangabad and neighbouring Peykan were among its important villages; after a period of decline they recovered their standing by the Qajar era, when Peykan served as the district's administrative centre.
simp_chinese: 扬加巴德位于伊斯法罕东南的贾尔库耶地区，干旱内陆散布着绿洲村庄。耕地依赖地下渠道引来的水，与远处荒原形成对照。当地分为上、下贾尔库耶，两区各有一串聚落。扬加巴德与邻近的佩坎是其中重要村庄；经历衰落后，到卡扎尔时代两地恢复了地位，佩坎成为地区行政中心。

english: Yangam was a fortified district in the inland country east of Sŏngch'ŏn. During the Red Turban invasion of 1361, the Koryŏ commander Yi Pangsil asked that its people and grain be moved to the stockade at Chŏllyŏng, together with those of neighbouring districts. In 1396 the new Joseon government combined Yangam with Sudŏk to form the county of Yangdŏk.
simp_chinese: 阳岩是成川以东内陆的一处设防地区。1361年红巾军入侵时，高丽将领李芳实请求将当地及邻近州县的居民和粮食迁往岊岭木栅，以备防御。1396年，新建立的朝鲜王朝将阳岩与树德合并，设立阳德县。

english: Yangbei lies west of the Cang Mountains on the Yangbi River. Its name appears in ninth-century records among the local kingdoms of the Nanzhao era and later belonged to a patrol district and a post station. The Bonan road passed through this mountain country on its way west from Dali. During the Hongzhi reign of the Ming, officials of Menghua and Yongchang joined in building an iron-chain bridge across the Yangbi, helping travelers cross the river.
simp_chinese: 样备位于苍山以西的漾濞江畔。九世纪的记载已将样备列为南诏时期的地方诏国之一，后来这里设有巡检司和驿站。博南古道从大理向西穿过山地，途经此处。明弘治年间，蒙化与永昌官府共同出资，在漾濞江上修建铁索桥，方便旅人渡江。

english: Yangcheng lies in the mountains of southeastern Shanxi. At Zhongdaozhuang, a fortified complex of courtyards was home to the Chen family, whose members gained distinction in scholarship and office. Its walls and towers sheltered a lineage that produced several successful examination candidates and officials. The most prominent was Chen Tingjing, who served the Kangxi emperor and became a grand secretary in 1703. He also oversaw the compilation of the Kangxi Dictionary. His family's residence, later known as the Imperial Chancellor's House, reflects the wealth and standing that generations of learning and service could bring to a Shanxi household.
simp_chinese: 阳城位于山西东南群山之中。中道庄的陈氏家族居住在设有城墙和楼阁的宅院内，家族中多人科举及第、出仕为官，以学问和仕途闻名。 其中最著名的是清代的陈廷敬。他侍奉康熙皇帝，1703年升任大学士，并主持《康熙字典》的编纂。陈氏住宅后来被称为皇城相府，体现了世代读书和仕宦为山西家族带来的财富与地位。

english: Lake Yangcheng lies northeast of Suzhou, its shallow waters woven into the rivers and channels of the Tai Lake plain. Old records call it Yangcheng Lake with several different characters. A Song account describes the Kunshan embankment receiving water from the lake on its northern side and releasing it toward the Song River in the south. Without a firm embankment, wind and waves could spread across the fields, turning cultivated land into water frequented by fish and turtles.
simp_chinese: 阳澄湖位于苏州东北，浅阔的湖水与太湖平原的河港相连。古籍中的湖名有阳城、杨城等不同写法。宋代记载称昆山塘北纳阳城湖、南通松江；堤防不坚时，风浪冲入田野，耕地便可能积水，成为鱼鳖出没之处。

english: Yangchun lies on the Moyang River in western Guangdong, among hills of limestone caves and underground streams. At Tongzhen Cave near Chunwan, visitors left inscriptions on the rock walls. In 1069 a Song official travelled upstream to see the cave, and local officials had his writing carved into the stone. The waterways and caves of the district have long formed part of its local landscape and memory.
simp_chinese: 阳春位于广东西部漠阳江流域，山间有石灰岩溶洞与地下溪流。春湾附近通真岩的石壁上留有游人的题刻。1069年，一位宋代官员乘船溯江游览此地，地方官将他的墨迹刻于岩壁，留下这次游山的记录。

english:
Yangdi is the ancient city of Han on the central Henan plain, which the Warring States ruler Han Jinghou made his capital in 400 BC and where the Qin placed Yingchuan Commandery. In 1184 the Jin renamed the department of Yingshun as Junzhou after an old terrace of the Xia, the Jun Tai, and the Yuan kept the name, adding Xinzheng and Mi to its lands in 1265. The city lay at the edge of the hills of Mount Ji, where a new kind of pottery took shape.

Potters here, some of whom may have come from the Ru kilns, made Jun ware, with a thick opalescent glaze that fired sky blue and moon white, and in the early and middle Ming the kilns inside Junzhou itself turned out high-fired copper-red flower pots and stands for the court, marked on the base with numbers that fall as the vessels grow larger. Private kilns around Shenhou made everyday bowls and dishes. In 1575 the city was renamed Yuzhou, to avoid the character Jun in the personal name of the Wanli Emperor, Zhu Yijun. Under the Ming and Qing its markets also made it one of the four great medicinal-herb marts of China.
simp_chinese:
阳翟是中原河南平原上的古城，战国时韩景侯于公元前400年定都于此，秦代在这里设颍川郡。金大定二十四年（1184年），因境内有夏代的钧台旧址，颍顺州更名钧州，元朝沿用此名，至元二年（1265年）又把新郑、密县划归钧州。城市位于箕山山麓，一种新的瓷器就在这一带兴起。

这里的窑工，其中一部分可能来自汝窑，烧出了钧瓷：厚釉乳浊，呈天蓝与月白之色。明代早中期，钧州城内的窑场为宫廷烧造高温铜红釉花盆和盆托，器底刻有数目字，器形越大数字越小；神垕一带的民窑则烧制日常的碗盘。明万历三年（1575年），为避万历皇帝朱翊钧名讳中的“钧”字，钧州改名禹州。明清时期，禹州药材市场兴旺，是全国四大中药材集散地之一。

english: Yangdzong is a Bon monastery in the high country of eastern Tibet, also known as Jazé Yangdzong. It was founded in 1413 by Khyungpo Bumgyel Drakpa, a teacher associated with the religious traditions of the region. The monastery belongs to a landscape of mountain communities where Bon institutions endured alongside the monasteries of Tibetan Buddhist schools.
simp_chinese: 羊卓此处指藏东高地的嘉则央宗寺，简称央宗，是一座苯教寺院。它由琼波奔杰扎巴于1413年创建，属于这一地区的宗教传统。藏东山地社群中，苯教寺院与各派藏传佛教寺院长期并存。

english: Yangga is a name recorded among Aboriginal language varieties of inland north Queensland. It is associated with the wider Biri group. The river country between the Belyando and Burdekin lies west of the coastal ranges, where wooded plains and creeks form part of a broad inland landscape.
simp_chinese: 扬加是昆士兰北部内陆原住民语言变体的一个记载名称，与更广泛的比里语群相关。贝利安多河与伯德金河之间的河流地区位于海岸山脉以西，林地平原和溪流构成广阔内陆景观的一部分。

english: Yanggu lies in a mountain basin of central Korea, among streams feeding the North Han River. In Koryŏ times the Suin relay station connected the district with the roads around Ch'unju. A Confucian school was founded below Mount Pibong in 1405, early in the Joseon dynasty, giving the county a place for instruction and rites in honour of Confucius and the sages.
simp_chinese: 杨口位于朝鲜中部的山间盆地，周围溪流汇入北汉江。高丽时期，遂仁驿将这一地区接入春州周围的驿路。朝鲜王朝初期，杨口于1405年在飞凤山下创建乡校，为当地提供讲学及祭祀孔子、先贤的场所。

english: Yanggu lies on the western Shandong plain, north of the Yellow River. Its county town was established at Mengdian in 1006, after earlier moves, while the Grand Canal passed through the eastern part of the county. Canal traffic brought prosperity but depended on an elaborate system of water control. In 1453, the Ming official Xu Youzhen oversaw the digging of the Guangji Canal and the building of a sluice at Zhangqiu to regulate water drawn from the Yellow and Qin rivers for navigation.
simp_chinese: 阳谷位于鲁西平原、黄河北岸。县治几经迁移，于1006年定于孟店；大运河则经过县境东部。运河漕运带来繁盛，也依靠复杂的水利设施维持。1453年，明朝官员徐有贞主持开凿广济渠，并在张秋建通源闸，调节引自黄河、沁河的济运水源。

english:
Yangguan lies southwest of Dunhuang, on the desert approaches toward the western regions. Fortified under the Western Han, it became one of the great frontier passes alongside Yumenguan to the north. Its earlier role gives context to a place whose routes and political control changed substantially in later centuries.

The Tang poet Wang Wei made Yangguan an enduring image of farewell in his poem for a friend traveling west. Its musical setting, Yangguan Sandie, continued to circulate in later centuries; the earliest surviving score dates to the Ming. The pass's literary memory should be distinguished from the changing use of roads and settlements around Dunhuang during the Ming and Qing periods.
simp_chinese:
阳关位于敦煌西南的沙漠通道上，通向西域。西汉时这里修筑关防，与北面的玉门关同为著名边关。这段较早的历史为理解其后数百年交通与政治格局的变化提供了背景。

唐代诗人王维在送友人西行的诗中，使阳关成为长久流传的离别意象。由诗歌发展出的《阳关三叠》在后世传唱，现存最早曲谱可追溯至明代。关隘的文学记忆，应与明清时期敦煌周边道路和聚落用途的变化区分开来。

english: Yŏnghŭng Bay opens eastward on Korea's northeastern coast, between the Hodo and Kalma peninsulas. Unlike much of the straighter eastern shoreline, it contains numerous small bays and islands. Rivers flow into its shallow inner waters, and the coast includes sandy beaches as well as deeply indented inlets. The towns around the bay look out across the larger waters of East Korea Bay.
simp_chinese: 永兴湾位于朝鲜东北海岸，向东开口，处在虎岛与葛麻半岛之间。它有众多小湾和岛屿，与东海岸多数较为平直的岸线不同。河流注入浅水内湾，沿岸既有沙滩，也有深入陆地的海湾。湾畔诸邑面向更广阔的东朝鲜湾水域。

english: Yangi, or Yangi Taraz, was a town of the Talas valley known in the Mongol period. Its name, meaning New Taraz, recalls the older city downstream and the changes that overtook the valley after the Mongol conquests. Coins bearing the names of Taraz and Yangi Taraz testify to the circulation of money in the region under the Chagatai rulers. The valley remained a meeting place for rival princes as they struggled for power in Central Asia.
simp_chinese: 养夷，又称新怛罗斯，是蒙古时期塔拉斯河谷的一座城镇。“新怛罗斯”之名使人联想到下游的古城，以及蒙古征服后河谷所经历的变化。铸有怛罗斯和新怛罗斯名称的货币，见证了察合台统治时期这一地区的货币流通。诸王争夺中亚权力时，河谷仍是他们会聚之地。

english:
Yangikent, the “New Town” also known as Jankent, stood on the lower Syr Darya east of the Aral Sea. Arab geographers of the tenth century described it as the seat of the Oghuz yabghu, ruler of a federation of Turkic peoples. Its position connected the steppe with Khwarazm and the routes leading toward the Volga and Central Asia.

The settlement was already inhabited in the sixth century. In the late ninth century it was rebuilt as a walled town, its plan showing the influence of Khwarazmian urban traditions. Inside the walls stood a citadel and residential quarters, while crafts and commerce brought together settled inhabitants and the surrounding pastoral world. Yangikent eventually declined and was abandoned; the changing courses of the river and shifts in political and commercial life have all been considered possible factors in its disappearance.
simp_chinese:
养吉干又称詹肯特，意为“新城”，坐落在咸海以东的锡尔河下游。十世纪的阿拉伯地理学者称它是乌古斯叶护的驻地；叶护统领着突厥诸部的联盟。城镇的位置将草原与花剌子模以及通往伏尔加河和中亚腹地的道路联系起来。

这处聚落在六世纪已有居民。九世纪末，它被重建为一座有城墙的城镇，布局体现出花剌子模城市传统的影响。墙内有城堡和住宅区，手工业与商业则使定居居民同周围牧业世界相联系。养吉干后来衰落并被废弃；河道变迁以及政治、贸易格局的变化，都被认为可能是其消失的原因。

english: Yangirabod lies near the Nurata Mountains, north of the Zarafshan valley. At nearby Nurata a spring called Chashma rises below the old fortress and has long been a place of pilgrimage. The tenth-century historian Narshakhi described a burial ground there, while mosques later stood beside the water. The spring gave this dry mountain margin a dependable source of water.
simp_chinese: 扬吉拉巴德位于努罗塔山附近，泽拉夫善河谷以北。附近的努罗塔有一处名为恰什马的泉水，涌出于古堡之下，长期以来是朝圣地。十世纪史家纳尔沙希记载过此处的墓地，后来泉旁又建起清真寺。泉水为干旱的山地边缘提供了稳定水源。

english: Yangjiang lies on the southwestern coast of Guangdong, where the Moyang River reaches the sea. Its harbour and nearby Hailing Island lay along routes followed by ships travelling between China and lands across the South China Sea. In the Song period the port served coastal shipping and trade, with connections to the ports of eastern China. Boats could find shelter along this shore before continuing their journeys.
simp_chinese: 阳江位于广东西南沿海，漠阳江在此入海。阳江港与附近海陵岛处在通往南海诸地的航路上。宋代港口服务沿海航运与贸易，与中国东部港口有所往来，船只可在这片海岸寻找停泊之处，再继续航行。

english: Yangjibaliq, a Turkic name meaning “new city”, stood near the Manas River on the northern side of the Tian Shan. Medieval writers recorded several forms of its name, including Changbalik. The city appears in the geography of the Yuan dynasty among the lands of a Chagatai prince. Its position beside mountain-fed water placed it between the Tian Shan and the open country of the Dzungarian Basin.
simp_chinese: 仰吉八里在突厥语中意为“新城”，位于天山北侧玛纳斯河附近。中世纪文献以多种音译记载此城，包括昌八剌等名称。《元史》地理记载将它列入察合台后王的属地。这里靠近来自山地的水源，地处天山与开阔的准噶尔盆地之间。

english: Yangju lies north of Hanyang in the river and mountain country surrounding the Korean capital. As the early Joseon court established its new capital, the district's administrative seat was moved to Kyŏnju in 1397. Yangju was raised to a protectorate in 1413 and to a higher provincial rank in 1466. Its proximity to the capital made it part of the country through which roads led northward.
simp_chinese: 杨州位于汉阳以北，坐落在朝鲜都城周围的河流与山地之间。朝鲜王朝初期营建新都时，当地治所于1397年迁至见州。杨州于1413年升为都护府，1466年又升为牧。它靠近京城，是北行道路经过的地区。

english: Yangman country lies in the inland river region south of the Roper River in northern Australia. Yangman is one of the Aboriginal languages associated with the western Roper catchment, near Mangarayi and Jawoyn country. Seasonal streams flow through woodland and savanna across this tropical interior.
simp_chinese: 阳曼人的土地位于澳大利亚北部罗珀河以南的内陆河流地区。阳曼语是与罗珀河西部流域有关的原住民语言之一，邻近曼加拉伊和贾温人的土地。季节性溪流穿过这片热带内陆的林地和稀树草原。

english:
Yángqǔ was the county that held Tàiyuán, the capital of Shānxī, and its lands ran north from the city walls to the passes of Shílǐng and Tiānmén, the gates of the Taiyuan basin toward the frontier. By the Jīn its seat shared the prefectural city, and under the Yuán, Míng and Qīng the provincial, prefectural and county offices all stood within the same walls.

The Míng made the city a princely seat. Zhū Gāng, third son of the Hóngwǔ Emperor, was named Prince of Jìn in 1370; in 1376 Xiè Chéng extended the walls on three sides to a circuit of twenty-four lǐ with eight gates, and in 1378 the prince came to live in Taiyuan. In 1381 he enlarged the Chóngshàn Temple in memory of his mother, Empress Mǎ, and under the Wànlì Emperor the twin thirteen-storey pagodas of the Yǒngzuò Temple rose one after the other on a hill outside the southeast gate. In 1644 Lǐ Zìchéng took the city and seized the last Prince of Jin, Zhū Qiúguì, and in 1649 the Qīng walled off a Manchu garrison quarter in its southwest corner. Fù Shān, a Yangqu man, put on Daoist dress after the fall of the Ming and in 1678 refused to sit the court's special examination.
simp_chinese:
阳曲是山西省城太原的附郭县，县境从城北一直延伸到石岭关、天门关，那是太原盆地通往北方边地的门户。至迟从金代起，阳曲县治便与太原府同城；元明清三代，省、府、县三级衙署同在一座城中。

明代太原是藩王驻地。洪武三年（1370年），太祖第三子朱棡受封晋王；洪武九年（1376年），永平侯谢成把城墙向东、南、北三面展筑，周围二十四里，开八门；洪武十一年（1378年），晋王就藩太原。洪武十四年（1381年），晋王为纪念母亲马皇后扩建崇善寺；万历年间，东南门外的高冈上先后立起永祚寺的两座十三层佛塔。1644年，李自成攻破太原，俘获末代晋王朱求桂；1649年，清廷在城内西南隅筑起满洲城。阳曲人傅山在明亡后改着道装，1678年朝廷开博学鸿词科，他坚辞不就。

english: Off Korea's southwestern coast, the Yellow Sea approaches a maze of islands and sheltered channels. The shoreline here is deeply indented, with peninsulas and offshore islands marking the meeting of sea and low hills. Farther south, the waters around Cheju connect with the strait between the island and the mainland. These coastal channels offered many passages through a landscape shaped by the sea.
simp_chinese: 朝鲜西南岸外，黄海通向岛屿和隐蔽水道交错的海域。这里的海岸线十分曲折，半岛与近海岛屿点缀着海水和低丘相接之处。更南方，济州附近的水域与岛屿、大陆之间的海峡相连。这片由海水塑造的海岸有许多可供穿行的水道。

english: Yangshan lies among the mountains of northern Guangdong. In 803 the Tang writer Han Yu was sent here as county magistrate after speaking about drought and hunger near the capital. His time in Yangshan left a lasting local memory: a mountain associated with his reading and teaching came to be called Xianling, the mountain of the worthy magistrate. A later Ming magistrate built a pavilion at a fishing place linked to Han.
simp_chinese: 阳山位于广东北部群山间。唐代803年，文学家韩愈因上疏谈及京畿旱灾与饥荒，被贬为阳山县令。他在当地留下深远的记忆，传说中读书讲学的山后来改称贤令山。明代县令又在相传韩愈垂钓的地方建亭纪念。

english: Yangshou was a county on the Liu River and the seat of Xiangzhou in central Guangxi. Its history was closely tied to that of the prefecture: the seat moved to Penglai Island in Laibin under the Southern Song, but returned to Yangshou in the Yuan period. The county lay among waterways that joined the Liu to the Qian River, connecting the surrounding districts with the larger river system of southern China.
simp_chinese: 阳寿是广西中部柳江边的一处县邑，也是象州州治所在。县城的沿革与象州密切相关：南宋时州治迁至来宾的蓬莱洲，元代又迁回阳寿。附近水道连接柳江与黔江，使周边地区与华南更广阔的江河水系相通。

english:
Yangshuo lies on the Li River in Guangxi, among steep limestone hills and cultivated valleys. The county was established in 590 under the Sui. Its name was traditionally associated with nearby Yangshuo Mountain, and the county remained linked administratively to the regional centre at Guilin through later dynasties.

Under the Yuan, Yangshuo belonged to Jingjiang circuit; the Ming renamed the jurisdiction Guilin prefecture, and the Qing retained that arrangement. The river and surrounding hills formed the setting of a long-established county whose administrative history was tied to Guilin.
simp_chinese:
阳朔位于广西漓江畔，石灰岩山峰环绕耕作谷地。隋开皇十年（590年）置县，传统记述将县名与附近阳朔山联系起来。此后，阳朔长期在行政上与桂林这一地区中心相连。

元代阳朔属于静江路；明代静江路改为桂林府，阳朔为其属县，清代仍沿此建置。漓江与周围山地构成了这座历史悠久的县城所处的环境。

english: Yangxin is an old county on the northern Shandong plain, established in the early Han. Its seat occupied several sites over the centuries, but the old town served as the county centre throughout the Yuan, Ming and Qing. Within it stood the county offices, a Confucian temple and Buddhist temples. The district was also known for its pears, grown on a substantial scale by the Ming and Qing and prized as a tribute fruit.
simp_chinese: 阳信是山东北部平原上的古县，始置于西汉初年。县治历经迁移，元、明、清三代都设在旧城。城中有县署、文庙及佛寺；县境还以鸭梨闻名，明清时期种植已有相当规模，梨果并作为贡品进献朝廷。

english: Yangyuan was a Tang county in the mountain country south of the Han River, within Yangzhou's jurisdiction. It was separated from Xixiang in the early Tang, with its seat in the region of Zhenba. Warfare later disrupted the county, and its administration was temporarily moved to Baituan, south of Xixiang. The county was abolished in the early ninth century. Its changing seat reflects the difficulties of governing the wooded valleys between the Hanzhong basin and the mountains to the south.
simp_chinese: 洋源是唐代洋州所辖县，位于汉江以南的山地。唐初从西乡析置，县治在镇巴一带。后来兵乱扰动县境，官署一度迁往西乡以南的白湍村。九世纪初，洋源县被撤销。治所的迁移反映了汉中盆地与南方群山之间林木河谷的治理难处。

english:
Yangzhou, written with a different first character from the canal city of the same name in Jiangsu, lay in the Han River country of southern Shaanxi. Its seat had moved to Xingdao, the site of the later Yang County, in 756. By the Yuan period it belonged to the Xingyuan circuit, with neighbouring districts brought under its administration. The river valley and the mountains around Hanzhong gave the place a role in communications between the basin and the lands beyond.

In the early Ming the prefecture was reduced to Yang County under Hanzhong, and several former districts were absorbed into it. A local gazetteer preserves notices of floods on the Han River, including an inundation in the Yongle reign that damaged the town and its dwellings. Its account also records the turmoil of Wu Sangui's rebellion: forces occupying the county in the 1670s extracted supplies and cut timber before Qing armies recovered the district. Such records show how a county seat on the Han River experienced both the routine burdens of administration and the upheavals of wider wars.
simp_chinese:
洋州位于陕西南部汉江流域，与江苏运河边更著名的扬州并非同一地点。756年，州治由今西乡一带迁至兴道，也就是后来的洋县县城。元代洋州隶属兴元路，附近若干县地归其管辖。汉水河谷与汉中周围的山岭，使这里处在盆地内外往来的通道上，州治因此兼有地方管理和交通上的地位。

明初洋州降为洋县，隶属汉中府，原来若干属县的土地并入县境。地方志保留了汉水泛滥的记录，永乐年间一次洪水淹及城郭和民居。清初吴三桂起兵后，部下在1670年代占据洋县，征取粮财、砍伐树木，直到清军收复地区。县志中的这些记载，让一座汉水边县城所承受的行政负担、水患与大规模战争有了具体面貌；河谷也并非只是地图上连接各地的一条通路。

english: Yángzǐ lay near the junction of the Yangtze and the canal leading north through Yángzhōu. As sand accumulated in the river, the island of Guāzhōu joined the northern bank and obstructed the old ferry approach. In 737 the official Qí Hàn cut the Yīlóu Canal across the new land, giving boats a more direct passage between the river and the canal.
simp_chinese: 扬子位于长江与经扬州北上的运河交汇处附近。江中泥沙淤积，瓜洲逐渐与北岸相连，阻塞了旧渡口的航路。唐开元二十五年（737年），齐澣开凿伊娄河穿过新生土地，使船只得以更直接地往来大江与运河。

english: Yanhe lies along the Wu River in northeastern Guizhou, where the water winds through steep wooded country. Its name recalls the riverbank, while nearby Youxi gave a second name to the hereditary chieftaincy established under the Yuan. The Ming retained the Yanhe Youxi office under Sinan Prefecture, with a Zhang chief and a Ran deputy holding their posts by succession. The river connected the scattered settlements of their district, forming a route through a landscape otherwise divided by mountains.
simp_chinese: 沿河位于贵州东北乌江两岸，江水蜿蜒穿过陡峻林山。地名取其沿江之意，附近的祐溪则给元代设立的世袭长官司带来另一半名称。明朝沿置沿河祐溪长官司，属思南府，由张氏正长官、冉氏副长官世袭。乌江连接着辖地散落的聚落，成为群山之间的重要通道。

english: Jänisjärvi lies north of Lake Ladoga in the Karelian lake country. Its roughly circular basin was formed by a meteorite impact hundreds of millions of years ago. Rivers and channels carry its waters southward to Ladoga, linking the inland lake with the great waterway on the Karelian frontier. Forests surround the lake, whose Finnish name means Hare Lake; its shores belonged to the communities of the northern Ladoga district.
simp_chinese: 耶尼斯耶尔维湖位于拉多加湖北面的卡累利阿湖区。它近乎圆形的湖盆由数亿年前一次陨石撞击形成。河流和水道将湖水向南带入拉多加湖，使内陆湖泊与卡累利阿边地的大水路相连。湖泊四周是森林，芬兰语湖名意为“兔湖”；湖岸属于拉多加湖北部地区的社群。

english: Yanjin lies north of the Yellow River on the Henan plain. In the county town stood Dajue Temple, founded under the Tang and rebuilt during the Xuande reign of the Ming. Its Wanshou Pagoda, a six-sided brick tower of seven storeys, was reconstructed over several decades and completed in 1585. Inscriptions within the tower recorded gifts toward the work, while a stele in the temple preserved calligraphy by the Yuan scholar Zhao Mengfu.
simp_chinese: 延津位于黄河北面的河南平原。县城的大觉寺创于唐代，明宣德年间重修。寺中万寿塔是六角七层砖塔，重建工程历时数十年，于1585年竣工。塔内碑刻记载了捐资修塔的人们，寺中还保存着元代书法家赵孟頫书写的《长明灯记》碑。

english: South-west of Kaifeng, Zhuxian stood on the Jialu River and served as an outer port for the provincial city. Its waterways and roads carried merchants and goods across the central plain. During the Ming and Qing, the town became known for woodblock New Year prints. Workshops produced brightly coloured door gods and scenes from stories and opera; merchants carried the prints away by river boat and cart to markets far beyond Kaifeng.
simp_chinese: 开封西南的朱仙镇位于贾鲁河畔，曾是省城的外港。水陆道路将商人与货物送往中原各地。 明清时期，朱仙镇以木版年画闻名。作坊印制色彩鲜艳的门神和戏曲、故事人物；商人再用河船和车辆将年画运往开封以外的市场。

english: Yanovo, also called Vedomsha, was a village in the Pereyaslavl district belonging to Matvey Grigoryev, a member of the service gentry. Its church of Saint Nicholas was built in 1654 and rebuilt and consecrated in 1694. The parish records preserve the names of its clergy and the obligations attached to the church's lands. When the wooden building burned in 1783, a new church was built in the same year with the blessing of the bishop of Pereyaslavl.
simp_chinese: 亚诺沃又称韦多姆沙，是佩列亚斯拉夫尔县的一座村庄，曾属于服役贵族马特韦伊·格里戈里耶夫。当地圣尼古拉教堂建于1654年，1694年重建并重新祝圣。教区文书保留了神职人员的姓名及教堂土地承担的义务。1783年，木教堂在火灾中烧毁，当地在佩列亚斯拉夫尔主教的祝福下于同年建起新教堂。

english: Yanque stands amid the agricultural terraces of the Colca Valley in southern Peru. The valley was home to the Collagua people, whose fields climb the steep slopes above the river. Under Spanish rule Yanque became the center of the province of Collaguas and a Franciscan mission. Its church and plaza reflected colonial institutions, while divisions between upper and lower communities continued to shape the organization of the town and its surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 扬克坐落在秘鲁南部科尔卡河谷的农业梯田之间。河谷是科利亚瓜人的家园，田地攀上河流上方的陡坡。西班牙统治下，扬克成为科利亚瓜省的中心和方济各会传教地。教堂与广场体现了殖民制度，而上、下社区之间的划分继续影响城镇及周围乡村的组织。
